## Papers

**[Weighing rival explanations: Rwanda's 2025 tin excess](tin_rival_weighing/tin_rival_weighing.html)**
**October 2026** <br>
Tests a supplier's declared tin volumes against public trade and customs records. On Rwanda's 2025 exports, the test locates 1,305–1,512 t of ore with no declared source, but not its origin.

**[The war-risk screen: Gleaning signal from noise in maritime conflict shipping](war_risk_check/war_risk_check.html)**
**September 2026** <br>
Screens out false SAR structural damage leads with minimal open imagery, cutting projected costs of real-time verification by 88% on the Ras Isa case.

**[SAR blindness: Wet soil, small footprints](sar_blindness/sar_blindness.html)**
**August 2026** <br>
Why open-access SAR radar missed 31 km of newly-built siege walls, and what can be done to increase detection capacity for small-footprint structures.
